questions.stem: Why were all the planes grounded this morning?
questions.explain:
grounded禁足：A child or young person who is grounded is not allowed to
go out as a
punishment；是名詞、動詞、形容詞都有，更複雜的是它還是grind (v) 的過
去式或過去分詞。Ground 的動詞意義是從名詞延伸出來的–就是有觸地，填
地，壂地基的意思。 用在 禁足的用法，是飛機開始普遍以後；軍事上，若是
飛機機能有問題或是維修時飛機就不能飛.，故稱之觸地，引申為禁足。一般
而言，用在禁足的用法，一定是以被動的形態，而且可以用在各種事物上像
飛機，甚至於不會飛的，像車輛、馬、牛，甚至用在人、隊伍或是抽象的功
能上，例句如下：
The air plane was grounded due to the hydraulic system.
The T-5 tanks are grounded by fuel shortage.
The team is grounded for flagrant fouls.
Jack is grounded by his father for bad grades.
The city government civil services were grounded by the heavy snow last
night.
weather: foggy有霧的

I haven't made any plans yet. How about you?
I am planning an overseas tour.
Where is the man planning to go?

questions.explain:
overseas (a or adv): 在海外的,到國外的; abroad (adv): in or to a foreign
country or countries;
We always go abroad in the summer. Trek (v): to walk a long distance,
usually over land such as hills, mountains, or forests （徒步）長途跋涉，翻
山越嶺

questions.stem: W: Why do you often eat out? M: I don't want to have meals at home. W: Why not? M: To be honest, you are a lousy cook. Q: What does the man mean?

options.A: The lady is not good at cooking.
options.B: The lady is a great cook.
options.C: The lady likes to eat out.
options.D: The lady is afraid of cooking.

turns.t: Why do you often eat out?
I don't want to have meals at home.
Why not?
To be honest, you are a lousy cook.
What does the man mean?

questions.explain: lousy (a): = terrible非常糟糕的

questions.stem: M: How was the party last night? W: Everyone was having a good time until Jeff got drunk. M: And then? W: He began to swear at everyone. M: What a killjoy! (a person who spoils other people's pleasure ) Q: What does the man mean?

options.B: Jeff was happy at the party.
options.C: Jeff was sober at the party.

turns.t: How was the party last night?
Everyone was having a good time until Jeff got drunk.
And then?
He began to swear at everyone.
What a killjoy! (a person who spoils other people's pleasure )
What does the man mean?

questions.explain:
swear at…: 詛咒,罵髒話; killjoy: 令人掃興的人（或事）wet blanket: a person
who says or does something that stops other people enjoying themselves 掃
興的人

questions.stem: W: May I have your passport and ticket, please. M: Here you are. I would like to have a window seat, please. W: I'll see what I can do. I'm sorry, sir. They are all taken. Q: What is the woman doing?

options.A: She is checking if any window sets are available.
options.B: She is working as a waitress.
options.C: She is working as a ticket inspector.
options.D: She is working as a hair-dresser.

turns.t: May I have your passport and ticket, please.
Here you are. I would like to have a window seat, please.
I'll see what I can do. I'm sorry, sir. They are all taken.
What is the woman doing?

questions.explain:
taken: occupied, take 的過去分詞, 拿走，移走; inspector (n): someone
whose job is to officially inspect something 檢查員；視察員

questions.stem: W: Do you have any ketchup? M: Yes, of course. I'll bring some right away. Anything else? W: I'd like to see the menu again. Q: Where are they?

turns.t: Do you have any ketchup?
Yes, of course. I'll bring some right away. Anything else?
I'd like to see the menu again.
Where are they?

questions.explain: ketchup (n): 蕃茄醬; menu: 菜單

questions.stem: W: Hi John, you do not look yourself today. What happened? M: My new girlfriend stood me up last night. Q: What does the man mean?

options.A: His girlfriend didn't show up last night.
options.B: His girlfriend did show up last night.
options.C: His girlfriend had to work late.
options.D: He is happy with his girlfriend.

turns.t: Hi John, you do not look yourself today. What happened?
My new girlfriend stood me up last night.
What does the man mean?

questions.explain:
(not) look oneself: 看起來(不)跟往常一樣; stand sb up: 故意對某人失約，放
（某人）的鴿子; show up: to arrive somewhere到達，露面

questions.stem: With a higher salary, buying a new car became a(n)___________ option for Jim.
questions.explain:
此句話將介系詞放在句首作為副詞，修飾主詞buying a new car。salary表
「薪水」，從句意上來說，有了較高的薪水，買車對Jim來說變成一個可行、
可負擔的option(選項)，故選affordable，表「負擔得起的」。
整句翻譯為：有了較高的薪水，買車對Jim來說變成一個負擔得起的選項。

questions.stem: Sally watched the workers ________ the luggage onto the plane.
questions.explain:
luggage為行李，交通工具是飛機，worker(勞工)將行李裝載到飛機上，用
load，表「裝載」。load something into/onto something指將大量的某些東⻄
搬運到交通工具或容器中。
整句翻譯為：Sally看著勞工把行李裝載上飛機。

questions.stem: All of our product are __________, so it won't be difficult to install them.
questions.explain:
user-friendly電腦軟體易使用的，易懂的，用戶界面友好的：If something,
especially
something related to a computer, is user-friendly, it is simple for people to
use, eco-friendly環保的：Eco-friendly products have been designed to do
the least possible damage to the environment.

questions.stem: The ______ of a new gun law has been difficult for police.
questions.explain:
gun是槍，law指法律，a new gun law(新的槍枝管制法)當然要由警察來執
行，因此答案選
enforcement，表「實施，執行」。
整句翻譯為：這新槍枝管制法的執行對警方來說一直很困難。

questions.stem: Please do not get off the train ______ it comes to a complete stop.
questions.explain:
get off: 下車
complete stop: 完全停止
not... until...: 直到...才...
解析：句意為火車完全停妥前請勿下車。「not... until...」為固定搭配，表「直到…才…」，因此答案選C。干擾項 when（當…時）、while（在…期間）與 if（如果）代入後語意矛盾，會變成「停妥時不要下車」，不合常理。

questions.stem: The noise from the street really ____ Tammy.
questions.explain:
bother最常以動詞的型態出現，在此句中表「打擾；使惱怒」。此句中提到
The noise(喧擾聲；噪音)…，噪音通常會使人感到不愉快或受干擾，因此所
有選項中最符合的只有bother。
整句翻譯為：街上的噪音使Tammy惱怒。

questions.stem: Not only the students but also the teachers _______ down with the flu.
questions.explain:
not only A but also: 如果連接兩個動詞時，前後的時式要一致；如用於連接兩
個主詞時，重點在第二個主詞，因此動詞須與第二個主詞一致。
Not only you but (also) I am to blame. 不僅你，連我都要受責難。
Not only the students but also the teacher was at the party.不僅學生，連老
師都去了派對。
若連接對等的<主要子句>，而由 not merely，not only 開頭，則要用倒裝形
式。
Not only did the dog bark at her, but it also bit her. 這隻狗不但對她叫，而且
咬了她。
Not only was my boss full of praise for me, but he also promised to give me
a raise.
老闆不僅讚美我，同時要幫我加薪。

questions.stem: Calm down, Tom. You're _________ too nervous now.
questions.explain:
calm down: 冷靜下來
nervous: 緊張的
解析：題意為「冷靜點，湯姆。你現在太緊張了。」句中 You're 是 You are 的縮寫，後方接現在分詞 being 形成進行式，表示「當下暫時表現得...」，故答案選A。干擾選項 B 與 D 均為完成式分詞，不可直接接在 are 後；C 為不定詞，文法不符。

questions.stem: Her headaches got more and more _______ as the night went on.
questions.explain:
headache表「頭痛」，went on為常用片語go on的過去式，表「(時間)流
逝；經過」，as the night went go則為隨著夜晚的流逝。頭痛隨著夜深了而
加劇，因此選intense，表「強烈的；劇烈的」。
整句翻譯為：她的頭痛隨著夜晚流逝變得越來越強烈。

questions.stem: ________ the volcano erupt again, it might destroy the whole village.
questions.explain:
should 置於句首，而省略 if, 意思是「萬一」
If anyone should come, say I am not at home. 萬一有人來訪，就說我不在
家。
Should anyone come, say I am not at home.

questions.stem: Nothing is more precious than time, yet nothing is ________ valued.
questions.explain:
Nothing is more precious than time, yet nothing is less valued (than time). 世
界上最寶貴的是時間，而最不值錢的也是時間。less和nothing雙重否定表肯
定，更加強語氣。

questions.stem: Billy cried when his mom cleaned his wound with ________.
questions.explain:
這句話的句構很簡單，用…清理某人的wound(傷口)，當然只能選用具有消炎
成分的東⻄來處理傷口，因此選alcohol，表「酒精」。
整句翻譯為：當Billy的媽媽用酒精幫他清理傷口時，他哭了。

questions.stem: If I'm three years older than you, I'm 3 years your _______ .
questions.explain:
superior: high class; inferior: lower, secondary
senior: elder, superior; junior: lower, secondary

questions.stem: In recent years an increasing number of people _______ health- conscious.
questions.explain:
recent (Adj) recently (Adv) Our foreign trade has expanded greatly in recent
years.
我國的對外貿易近年來已有極大發展。(動詞用完成式)

questions.stem: Elsa _________ a plan to pay off her credit card debt by the end of the year.
questions.explain:
此句的重點擺在to後面所接的整個句子，to有為了… 的意思，pay off表「付
清」，debt是「債務」。因此我們可得知，為了付清債務，Elsa實施或擬定
了一個計劃，故選initiate，表「開始實施」。
整句翻譯為：為了在年底前還完卡債，Elsa實施了一個計劃。

questions.stem: The _______ response to Emily's new hairstyle was positive.
questions.explain:
此句中，The… response(反應) to Emily's new hairstyle為主詞，was為動
詞，positive為形容詞，意指…對Emily新髮型的反應是positive(正面的)。因
此我們該選overall，表「全部的」，在整體語句上較通順。
整句翻譯為：大家對Emily新髮型的整體評價是正面的。

questions.stem: A drug lord along with two body guards ________ arrested yesterday.
questions.explain:
along with和…一起，則是種插入語(如together with, as well as的用法)
He took his dog along with him.
The teacher along with his students goes to the park every weekend.
Tobacco is taxed in most countries, along with alcohol.除了酒之外，菸草在
很多國家都要課稅(包括酒)。

questions.stem: There will be no additional ________ for delivery, I assure you.
questions.explain:
charge: to ask an amount of money for something, especially a service or
activity
a. Customer need to provide full mailing address to avoid delay of delivery
or extra charges incurred. 顧客必須提供完整地址以免延誤寄達及額外行政費
用的發生
b. Infant Travel Policy-Additional charges may apply.嬰兒旅行政策－可能收
取額外費用 。

questions.stem: I don't have enough cash. Might I use _______?
questions.explain:
cash: 現金
plastic: 塑膠、信用卡
fabric: 布料、織物
garlic: 大蒜
解析：題意為「我現金不夠，能用信用卡嗎？」。美語口語常以 plastic 代指信用卡（塑膠貨幣），故答案選C。選項 A（經典的）、B（布料）、D（大蒜）皆為字尾發音相近的押韻干擾字，與付款語意完全不符。

questions.stem: Jill was very _______ when she saw that someone had scratched her car door.
questions.explain:
scratch指刮或抓，當Jill看到她的車門被刮時，她非常的upset，表「生氣的；
苦惱的」。
整句翻譯為：當Jill看到有人刮了她的車門時，她非常生氣。

questions.stem: You have to use a _________ to loosen the metal nuts.
questions.explain:
wrench扳手：a tool for holding and turning objects, especially one that can
be made larger and smaller to hold different sized objects；torch火炬，手電
筒：a small light that is held in the hand and usually gets its power from
batteries.

questions.stem: My parents don't care what I will major in ____________ I'm interested in it.
questions.explain:
as long as: As long as you study, it’s very easy to receive a score higher
than 80.
只要你有念書，要拿80分以上是非常簡單的。
as far as: As far as I can think of, this is the best plan we have now.
這是目前我能想到最好的計畫。
as soon as: As soon as I left home this morning, the phone rang. 我今早一出
門，電話就響了。
as well as: I’m extremely busy recently. I have two presentations as well as
three final exams next week. 我最近非常忙，下星期有兩個報告還有三個期
末考試。

questions.stem: I usually travel ________ because I don't like to pack things.
questions.explain:
to travel light: to bring very few things with you when you go somewhere:
I like to carry my bags onto the plane, so I try to travel light.

questions.stem: The newspaper did a _______ to find out what kind of news people liked to read.
questions.explain:
此句要選出正確答案，需要了解後半句的意思。後半的句子由to開頭，表達為
了做某件事，to後面接的動詞find out…，表「發現；探究」，則是目的。因
此我們可以推敲「為了…，報紙做了某件事情」，所有的選項中，最符合的
就是survey，表「調查」。do a survey/ carry out a survey 皆表「執行調
查」。
整句翻譯為：為了瞭解人們喜歡閱讀怎樣的新聞，報紙做了一份調查。

questions.stem: We need __________ from our customers to make improvements.
questions.explain:
improvements改善：an occasion when something gets better or when you
make it better

questions.stem: These plants are ____ in this country. You can only see them in high mountains.
questions.explain:
從開頭句中的主詞plants可看出此句是在討論植物，要選出正確的答案，重點
在第二句話You can only see them in high mountains. (你只能在高山上看到
他們。)，既然這種植物只能在特定地點被看到，表示他們很rare，表「稀有
的；罕見的」。
整句翻譯為：這種植物在這國家很罕見，你只能在高山上看到他們。

questions.stem: There ________ neither tap water nor electricity in the house.
questions.explain:
neither A nor B(或either A or B):為對等連接詞,若連接兩個主詞,動詞要與nor
後的主詞一致，因為nor/or的關係(也和中文邏輯一樣，or意謂A 和B是獨立的
事件/個體,所以動詞依最近的主詞做變化。
Neither my parents nor my sister is here .
There is neither exciting news nor interesting jokes in this paper. 看靠近動詞
的主詞(exciting news)決定動詞，而exciting news是不可數名詞，是單數，所
以用is

questions.stem: The armored vehicle needs a complete ________.
questions.explain:
overhaul全面檢查，大修：to repair or improve something so that every part
of it works as it should

questions.stem: This is the hat _________ I paid fifty dollars. Cool, isn't it?
questions.explain:
「介係詞+關係代名詞」用法
a. The day when I'm forced to give up riding will be a sad day for me.
-->The day on which I’m forced to give up riding will be a sad day for me.
b. He lives in the street where all the houses are surrounded by high fences.
-->He lives in the street in which the houses are surrounded by high fences.
c. Which organization does he work for?在問句中較常使用
For which organization does he work? (Formal)
以下例句中介係詞放在句尾時在“嚴正聲明”時亦可以使用，此用法that是可以
代替who, which或甚至把關代省略不用
d. He works for a spy network, about which I know nothing.
-->He works for a spy network (which) I know nothing about.
e. The people with whom he worked have all been arrested. (Formal)
The people (who) he worked with have all been arrested. (Informal)
f. This is the bedroom in which he was murdered. (Formal)
This is the bedroom (that) he was murdered in. (Informal)

questions.stem: The soccer _________ official decided to cancel all weekend matches due to heavy rain.
questions.explain:
official指官員，match為比賽，due to為慣用片語，表「由於…」。由於大
雨，足球賽被取消了，能決定是否取消比賽的只有足球聯賽的官員，因此選
league，表「同盟；聯盟」。
整句翻譯為：由於大雨的緣故，足球聯賽的官員決定取消整週末的比賽。

questions.stem: ________ as I sympathize with those victims. I am not able to help them.
questions.explain:
Much as: 雖然、儘管
sympathize with: 同情
victim: 受害者
解析：句意為雖然我很同情那些受害者，但我無能為力。「Much as + 主詞 + 動詞」為固定讓步句型，相當於 Although... very much，故答案選B。干擾項A的Even需接though或if才表雖然，Even as則表「正當…之際」；C與D的So和Ever皆無此讓步用法，純屬詞性干擾。

questions.stem: Let's go catch a movie, ________ ?
questions.explain:
shall we是語氣更肯定的建議，以let's ...開頭，後接附加問句「shall we?」
Well, let's go in, shall we? 嗯，我們進去吧，走吧？

questions.stem: Jack didn't have scissors so he used his teeth to cut the ________.
questions.explain:
此句中，Jack沒有scissor(剪刀)，所以他用牙齒代替剪刀，來弄斷某樣東⻄。
四個選項中，一般需要用剪刀剪斷，卻也能用牙齒弄斷的，只有ribbon，表
「緞帶」。
整句翻譯為：Jack沒有剪刀，所以他用牙齒把緞帶咬斷。

questions.stem: Jessie missed the _________ of living in a big city when she moved to the countryside.
questions.explain:
miss有常見的兩種意思，一是表「想念」，二是表「錯過(交通工具)」，在此
句中，後面敘述Jessie搬到了countryside(鄉下)，並談到她missed the…living
in a big city(在大城市生活)，因此可判斷這裡的miss表「想念」大城市的生
活。而在大都市生活與鄉下最大的不同就是其convenience，表「便利性」。
整句翻譯為：當Jessie搬到了鄉下，她懷念起在大城市中生活的便利性。

questions.stem: James doesn't live with his family. He lives _______ in Taipei.
questions.explain:
開頭第一句話就說明了James沒有跟他的家人一起住，那麼選項當中就僅有
alone可選，alone表「單獨地；獨自地」，為副詞，用來修飾前面的動詞
live。在這邊需注意的是alone和along的差異，along若當副詞，表「向前；一
起」，無法套用在此句中。
整句翻譯為：James沒有跟他的家人一起住，他獨自住在台北。

questions.stem: This gift is a ____ from my aunt.
questions.explain:
blessing在此句中當可數名詞，表「祝福」。這字常見的片語有a blessing in
disguise(偽裝；掩飾)，直譯為偽裝或掩飾的祝福，表「塞翁失馬焉知非
福」。
整句翻譯為：這份禮物是我舅媽給的祝福。

questions.stem: Alexander the Great made a lasting impression on mankind. He was a great king and leader. However, he met his equal or even his superior in Diogenes, who was a great philosopher. Now, however, anybody who is familiar with history knows Alexander, but few know Diogenes. According to the paragraph, _________.

options.A: Diogenes may have been superior to Alexander

questions.explain:
superior (a): better than average or better than other people or things of the
same type
好過其他的，優越的For babies, breastfeeding is superior to bottle-feeding.
inferior差的；比…次的 be familiar with: to know something or someone well
對…熟悉 I'm sorry, I'm not familiar with your poetry.

questions.stem: Many of our libraries, especially in smaller cities, were made possible by Andrew Carnegie. Born in Scotland, he came to the United States when he was 13. His money started many of the libraries in small cities of the United States. According to the paragraph, _______.

options.A: libraries were not tax supported until Andrew Carnegie started them.
options.B: Andrew Carnegie was a native-born citizen of the United States.
options.C: libraries not founded by Carnegie were closed down.
options.D: In small cities, many of the libraries were founded with Carnegie's funds.

questions.explain:
found (v): to bring something into existence創立,創辦 We are planning a
dinner to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the founding of the company.

questions.stem: Man: I've been working in the restaurant for 20 years. Woman: What's your specialty? Man: I specialize in making dessert. Q: What does the man do?

options.B: The man has his talents, which are making tasty meals.
options.C: The man is good at making cakes.
options.D: The man's major is working in the restaurant.

questions.explain:
specialty (n): subject that someone knows a lot about 專業,專長 His
specialty is tax law. specialize (v)

questions.stem: Occasionally a language will not have a word to describe a certain occurrence or new product. In such cases a word is often borrowed from another language. This borrowing is particularly common with scientific and technical terms. According to the paragraph, _______.

options.A: a language may drop technical terms
options.B: new words can be added to languages by borrowing
options.C: all languages have words to describe certain occurrences
options.D: borrowing scientific terms is not common

questions.explain:
occurrence (n): something that happens 發生的事, 遭遇 t's still not possible
to accurately predict the occurrence of earthquakes. scientific (a): relating to
science, or using the organized methods of science 科學的, 應用科學方法的
a scientific discovery/experiment/theory technical (a): relating to the
knowledge, machines, or methods used in science and industry
技術的
